instruction: Keep going to the previous song on Spotify until you reach a song by Silent Thunder.
notes: The queue cursor is abstracted as a non-cyclic chain of positions (pos-current -> pos-prev-1 -> pos-prev-2); the number of previous_song steps is unknown at planning time, so two steps are used as a representative instance and the chain ends at the Silent Thunder song to prevent overshooting. (may-go-previous) enforces the loop discipline: it is true initially (the instruction says to go back at least once), consumed by previous_song, and re-established only by show_current_song, so the agent must inspect the current song after every skip. spotify.show_current_song is modeled as checking the current song against the artist id obtained from spotify.search_artists (predicate checked). supervisor.complete_task takes the target position/song/artist as non-API record parameters so its precondition is exactly the lifted goal; the task asks no question, so complete_task carries no answer. Only the music player cursor changes, matching the evaluation.
